faqs.q: How fast is delivery in Dubai, Sharjah & Ajman?
faqs.a: Orders placed before the daily dispatch cut-off are delivered within 1-2 hours in Dubai and Sharjah, and same-day in Ajman. Live courier tracking is shared on WhatsApp once your rider is assigned.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to Abu Dhabi and other Emirates?
faqs.a: Yes. Abu Dhabi receives same-day evening delivery for orders confirmed before 3 PM. Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain are next-day via courier. Free delivery applies on orders above 450 AED across all UAE Emirates.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Cash on Delivery (COD) is our most popular option. We also accept Card on Delivery (the rider carries a terminal), Apple Pay, and secure payment links sent on WhatsApp before dispatch.

faqs.q: Are your products original? What about warranty?
faqs.a: Every item is 100% authentic, ESMA compliant, and arrives factory-sealed with verifiable batch codes. IQOS devices carry a 12-month UAE warranty — we handle the replacement for you, no service-center visits needed.

faqs.q: How do I order through WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Add your items to the cart and tap "Complete Order via WhatsApp". The app opens with your full order pre-typed — items, quantities and AED total. Just add your delivery address and press send. We confirm in under a minute.

cta_section.text: Not sure which TEREA flavor, ILUMA device, or disposable vape suits you best? Chat with our team for instant recommendations.

specsTable.Device Model: IQOS ILUMA i PRIME (Remix Flagship Edition)
specsTable.Compatible Sticks: TEREA™ Induction Sticks only (Do not use Heets)
specsTable.Consecutive Uses: Up to 3 uses without holder recharge

specsTable.Charging Time: Approx. 135 minutes via USB-C fast charging
specsTable.Holder Touch Screen: Digital LED battery & puff status indicator

products.description:
Experience the pinnacle of heated tobacco technology in Dubai. The IQOS ILUMA i PRIME Remix in Electric Purple represents Philip Morris International's most advanced innovation. Featuring the revolutionary bladeless Smartcore Induction System™, it heats tobacco from within the sealed TEREA stick without burning it, ensuring zero residue, no blade breakage, and absolutely no cleaning required.

The new touch screen on the holder shows your heating status, remaining puffs, and battery level at a glance. Featuring FlexPuff and Pause Mode, you can pause your session for up to 8 minutes and resume without wasting your stick. Available in Dubai, Sharjah, and Ajman with 1-2 hour express courier dispatch and official 12-month UAE warranty.

faqs.q: Can I use regular HEETS in the IQOS ILUMA i PRIME?
faqs.a: No, IQOS ILUMA devices only work with TEREA sticks designed with internal metal heating elements. Traditional HEETS will not heat in ILUMA devices.

faqs.q: How fast can this be delivered in Dubai?
faqs.a: We offer express delivery across Dubai within 1 to 2 hours of order confirmation. Same-day delivery is also available across Sharjah, Ajman, and Abu Dhabi.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty in the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes, all IQOS devices purchased through Vape Club Dubai come with our 12-month local replacement warranty covering manufacturer hardware defects.
